longDescription:
Learn to write a college essay that sounds like you. Draftmere teaches the craft in 12 short units, gives you a private place to draft, and checks your understanding with questions that explain every answer. It never writes your essay. Every word stays yours.

### How Each Unit Works
Story: a student with a real writing problem. Try it: a guided exercise that finds your own material. Build it: steps, plus a short worked example from an invented student with notes on what the writer did. Check it: a self-check list for your own draft.

12 UNITS
Finding your story. Structure. Voice. Specific details. The personal statement. Supplements and "why us". Revising. Common mistakes. Integrity. Activity descriptions. A recommendation-friendly profile. Interview stories.

### Your Drafting Space
Write privately on your phone or tablet with a live word count against the limit you choose, character count and read-aloud time. A five-pass revision checklist (story, shape, voice, detail, clean-up) keeps each rewrite focused. Drafts are stored only on your device.

### Practice That Adapts
216 original questions with a reason for every answer. Missed questions come back sooner. Pick Beginner, Curious or Scientist depth, quiz lengths of 5, 10 or 20, and a daily challenge with badges and a streak.

### Built for Honest Writing
Draftmere has no essay generator and no rewriting tool. A pledge screen and plain-language integrity notes explain what help is fine and what is not. Examples are invented and labelled for study, never for copying.

### Sources You Can Open
Advice is backed by university writing centres and application bodies. Every source opens in a reading sheet inside the app.

### Made for Teens
Works offline, no account. Text size from 50% to 300%. For ages 13 and up. The app asks your age once; people under 18 see only non-personalised ads, and under-13s cannot use it.
